request: Our group is preparing a methods section for a greenhouse experiment comparing several orchid accessions under gradual water restriction. The immediate deliverable is a single network representing the full cohort, which will later be discussed at a lab meeting. We have already separated the sample annotations from the expression measurements and verified that the accession names are not being used as gene identifiers. I am asking about the registered analysis capability here; I am not asking you to perform a new biological experiment, search for reference files, or interpret condition differences at this stage. Can PANDA make one cohort-wide TF-to-gene network for our orchid drought study using expression, motif edges and a matching TF interaction prior?
